page.overview:
Who is Baranj?

Baranj the Starseeker was a Evocii male Rifle Grenadier and sharpshooter who lived on Nal Hutta during the Cold War. He and a group of other Evocii had acquired a starship, which was cause for alarm for the Hutt Cartel. Rhamm, one of Suudaa Nem'ro's foremen, tasked an individual with killing Baranj and his followers as well as destroying the starship.

Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia
